name: Weaver's Shears

rarity.note: True Glimmer-wrought survival; named, tracked, Censer-listed.

summary: Four surviving pairs of Concord shears that cut any fibrous thing along a line both blades 'agree to' — cloth, rope, root, hair, and once, allegedly, a river's current. They refuse to cut what is sworn: oath-cords, wave-knots, and the white silk (if the last bolt exists) cannot be touched. The colleges' guild-marks are still on the handles; the Censer lists them as contained, which two of the four pairs would dispute.
origin: Concord of Weavers — college workshops, pre-Sundering
current_whereabouts: One pair in the Censer archive; one with the Wealdmark's orchard-tenders; one lost at sea with a Skeleton Court crew; one whose location is written only in the Ring-Vault.
properties: Cut anything fibrous along an agreed line — the user must genuinely intend the line
Cannot cut anything sworn: oaths, knots, compacts resist absolutely
The blades warm when brought near worked thread of any age
keepers: As above; the Censer's pair is used to cut confiscated knot-charms 'humanely'.
value_or_danger: A realm's debt. In the wrong hands: every oath on Aurelith becomes negotiable.
adventure_hooks: The lost-at-sea pair surfaces in a Skeleton Courts auction; three factions bid, none intend to pay.
Players must cut something sworn — the Compact's orchard-border hedge — and the shears are the only tool that can even try.
